questions.q: What was Chulli's reaction when he saw the cow on the tracks?
questions.explain: Chulli got scared when he saw the cow.

questions.q: Why was Chulli fascinated with cows?
questions.explain: Chulli was fascinated with cows because they were gentle.

questions.q: How did Chulli feel before seeing the cow on the tracks?
questions.explain: Chulli was shy before he saw the cow.
